scope: Synthetic native macOS/Tart external attachment preservation and ATIF journey
wrapper_note: Owned wrapper explicitly stopped after successful guest cleanup; VM stopped and old lease released.
limitations: Evidence applies to the exact listed old binary, not the later maintained/DC/polish candidate.
Missing CJK/emoji glyphs and crowded attachment presentation remain known UI limitations; Unicode clipboard integrity is separately checked.
Only this selected local PNG flow is covered; no full parity, general format, latency or performance claim.
ATIF is text-only metadata/evidence; attachment payload bytes are separate exports.
Profile-bound unmanaged pixel comparisons do not establish general sRGB fidelity.
Prior failed runs and diagnostic samples remain separate; no relabeling.
sanitization: No guest/host paths, nonce, process identifiers, source snapshots, transcripts, database contents or screenshots included.
